# Coastline Equity

> > Full-service property management company serving Southern California coastal and inland communities including Orange County, Los Angeles County, and San Diego County.

Coastline Equity Property Management specializes in residential property management across prime Southern California locations, offering comprehensive services including tenant screening, rent collection, property maintenance, and luxury rental management for investors and property owners.
